column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for preferences/settings (e.g., 'PREF001').
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing MembershipAndSpending(MemberReg).
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing SocialCommunity(SocialReg).
An enum (PrivacySettings_enum) for privacy level (Private, Friends Only, Public).
An enum (DataSharingConsent_enum) capturing how much data the fan consents to share (Partial, Minimal, Full).
An enum (NotifPref_enum) describing notifications setting (Important, All).
An enum (CommPref_enum) for communication method (SMS, Email, Push).
An enum (MarkPref_enum) describing marketing preference (Opted In, Selective, Opted Out).
An enum (LangSet_enum) specifying how language is handled (Translated, Auto, Original).
An enum (AccessSet_enum) describing access or UI customization (Standard, Custom, Enhanced).
A SMALLINT number of devices the fan uses with the service (e.g., 2).
An enum (LoginFrequency_enum) for login frequency (Rare, Monthly, Weekly, Daily).
A DATE indicating last login date (e.g., '2025-03-15').
An INT counting total sessions (e.g., 150).
An INT representing total hours spent online (e.g., 120).
A SMALLINT average daily minutes used (e.g., 45).
A SMALLINT peak number of concurrent sessions (e.g., 3).
A DECIMAL(3,2) measuring interaction consistency (0.00–1.00) (e.g., '0.85').
A DECIMAL(3,2) rating platform stability from the user’s perspective (0.00–1.00) (e.g., '0.90').
An enum (ConnectionQuality_enum) describing connectivity (Poor, Excellent, Good, Fair).
